gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.

gaps.sentence: The charity relies entirely on voluntary ___ (DONATE).
gaps.explanation: 'Voluntary donations' — gifts of money given willingly.
'Argument' — note the e is dropped from argue.

gaps.sentence: She gave a very ___ (CONFUSE) explanation of the rules.
gaps.explanation: 'Confusing' describes something that causes confusion; 'confused' describes the person affected.

gaps.sentence: He is one of the most ___ (SUCCESS) businessmen in the region.
The ___ (INTRODUCE) of the euro changed European trade.
gaps.explanation: 'The introduction of' — the noun for starting something new.
